metadataDescriptions./: Custom non-woven bags made in Kosovo for businesses nationwide. Explore wholesale bags, printing and 3D design, from Prishtina and Lipjan to every municipality.
metadataDescriptions./manufacturing: See Kobags bag manufacturing in Kosovo through original factory photos and videos. Explore non-woven PP material, custom printing, forming and finishing.
metadataDescriptions./sustainability: Understand the material behind Kobags bags. Read practical guidance on non-woven polypropylene, reuse, recycled content and local recycling requirements.
metadataDescriptions./certifications: Inspect the published Kobags ISO 9001 and ISO 14001 certificate scans, registration details, dates and issuer references. Download the original documents.
metadataDescriptions./industries: Find a Kobags bag shape for shops, grocery, gifting or events. Match published dimensions and handles to what you carry, then plan your branding.
metadataDescriptions./industries/retail: Choose branded non-woven bags around your retail products. Compare dimensions and handles, plan logo placement and prepare your wholesale requirements.
metadataDescriptions./products: Compare D-Cut, Handle, Box, T-Shirt and String bags from Kobags. Review published sizes and fabric weights, then customize your bag for a wholesale quote.
metadataDescriptions./products/d-cut-bag: A clean, lightweight shape with an integrated grip. A practical canvas for your next promotion.
metadataDescriptions./products/handle-bag: An everyday carry bag with comfortable handles and room for your brand to stand out.
metadataDescriptions./products/box-bag: A structured profile with a generous base for packaging that needs a little more room.
metadataDescriptions./products/t-shirt-bag: A familiar shopping shape with integrated handles for convenient everyday carrying.
metadataDescriptions./products/string-bag: A drawstring closure and simple profile for events, promotions and brand giveaways.
metadataDescriptions./samples: Plan a Kobags sample inquiry before ordering wholesale bags. Share the bag shape, material and destination so sample availability and terms can be confirmed.
metadataDescriptions./partners: Explore distribution, retail and commercial partnership opportunities with Kobags Group. Introduce your market and discuss the right wholesale bag model.
metadataDescriptions./partners/apply: Prepare a partnership inquiry for Kobags. Share your market, experience and preferred cooperation model to start a discussion about bag distribution.
metadataDescriptions./contact: Contact Kobags Group about non-woven bags, manufacturing or partnerships. Find the published telephone and email, or prepare a detailed wholesale inquiry.
metadataDescriptions./bags-kosovo: Plan custom bag orders for all 38 Kosovo municipalities, including Prishtina, Lipjan, Prizren, Peja, Gjilan and Ferizaj. Compare shapes, artwork and delivery needs.
metadataDescriptions./resources: Prepare a complete custom bag brief with Kobags buying guides. Check sizes, materials, logo files, printing, quantities and delivery information.
metadataDescriptions./blog: Read Kobags guides on non-woven bag materials, printing, product specifications and wholesale planning. Practical questions for your next branded bag order.
metadataDescriptions./blog/kobagsjourney: How your product choices become a specification the factory can work with.
metadataDescriptions./blog/whyswitchtokobags: Make the decision around your products, your customers and the details you can verify.
metadataDescriptions./blog/kobagsmission: A clear logo, a considered color and the right shape can make a simple bag feel intentional.
metadataDescriptions./blog/sciencebehindkobags: Material composition, recycled content and recyclability answer different questions.
metadataDescriptions./blog/benefitsofkobags: A short checklist makes your quote request easier to understand and compare.
metadataDescriptions./blog/helpingbusinesseskobags: Use a sample, a shared brief and a review process to make the change easier for your team.
